cbp_initialize_opening_stocks_good_livestock = {
	every_market_in_world = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_initialization_market
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_opening_source_quantity_raw
			value = "stockpile_in_market(goods:livestock)"
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_opening_source_quantity
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity_raw
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity_raw < 0 }
			cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 11 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity > 0
						cbp_audit_enabled_trigger = yes
					}
				}
			cbp_seed_opening_market_good_livestock = yes
		}
		else = {
			cbp_initialization_count_zero_source_market_good = yes
		}
	}
}

cbp_seed_opening_market_good_livestock = {
	goods:livestock = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_initialization_good }

	set_global_variable = {
		name = cbp_initialization_market_goods_checked
		value = {
			value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_goods_checked
			add = 1
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = {
		name = cbp_initialization_opening_source_total
		value = {
			value = global_var:cbp_initialization_opening_source_total
			add = scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = cbp_initialization_market_total_capacity value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = cbp_initialization_market_eligible_country_count value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = cbp_initialization_market_allocated_quantity value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = cbp_initialization_market_existing_stock_failure value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = cbp_initialization_market_negative_capacity_failure value = 0 }
	remove_global_variable = cbp_initialization_residue_recipient_selected

	scope:cbp_initialization_market = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market_country_cache_market }
	cbp_rebuild_countries_present_in_market = yes

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = cbp_livestock_stock_by_market
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = cbp_livestock_stock_by_market
						target = scope:cbp_initialization_market
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = cbp_initialization_existing_country_stock
					value = "variable_map(cbp_livestock_stock_by_market|scope:cbp_initialization_market)"
				}
			}
			else = {
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = cbp_initialization_existing_country_stock
					value = 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_initialization_existing_country_stock != 0 }
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_initialization_market_existing_stock_failure
					value = 1
				}
			}

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = {
							name = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
							target = scope:cbp_initialization_market
						}
					}
					save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
						name = cbp_initialization_country_capacity_raw
						value = "variable_map(cbp_stock_cap_by_market|scope:cbp_initialization_market)"
					}
			}
			else = {
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = cbp_initialization_country_capacity_raw
					value = 0
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_initialization_country_capacity
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_initialization_country_capacity_raw
					min = 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_initialization_country_capacity_raw < 0 }
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_initialization_market_negative_capacity_failure
					value = 1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_initialization_country_capacity > 0 }
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_initialization_market_total_capacity
					value = {
						value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_total_capacity
						add = scope:cbp_initialization_country_capacity
					}
				}
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_initialization_market_eligible_country_count
					value = {
						value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_eligible_country_count
						add = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_initialization_total_capacity
		value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_total_capacity
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_initialization_eligible_country_count
		value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_eligible_country_count
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_initialization_existing_stock_failure
		value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_existing_stock_failure
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_initialization_negative_capacity_failure
		value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_negative_capacity_failure
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_initialization_existing_stock_failure > 0 }
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_initialization_existing_stock_failures
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_initialization_existing_stock_failures
				add = 1
			}
		}
		cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 12 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_initialization_negative_capacity_failure > 0 }
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_initialization_negative_capacity_failures
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_initialization_negative_capacity_failures
				add = 1
			}
		}
		cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 13 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cbp_initialization_failure_detected }
			scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity <= 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_initialization_zero_source_count
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_initialization_zero_source_count
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cbp_initialization_failure_detected }
			scope:cbp_initialization_existing_stock_failure = 0
			scope:cbp_initialization_negative_capacity_failure = 0
			scope:cbp_initialization_total_capacity <= 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_initialization_zero_capacity_failures
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_initialization_zero_capacity_failures
				add = 1
			}
		}
		cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 14 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cbp_initialization_failure_detected }
			scope:cbp_initialization_existing_stock_failure = 0
			scope:cbp_initialization_negative_capacity_failure = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable_map = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
							is_key_in_variable_map = {
								name = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
								target = scope:cbp_initialization_market
							}
							"variable_map(cbp_stock_cap_by_market|scope:cbp_initialization_market)" > 0
						}
						save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
							name = cbp_initialization_country_capacity
							value = "variable_map(cbp_stock_cap_by_market|scope:cbp_initialization_market)"
						}
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_global_variable = cbp_initialization_residue_recipient_selected }
						}
						save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_initialization_residue_country
						set_global_variable = cbp_initialization_residue_recipient_selected
					}
					save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
						name = cbp_initialization_requested_country_quantity
						value = {
							value = scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity
							multiply = scope:cbp_initialization_country_capacity
							divide = scope:cbp_initialization_total_capacity
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:cbp_initialization_requested_country_quantity > 0 }
						cbp_add_stock = {
							country = this
							market = scope:cbp_initialization_market
							good = livestock
							quantity = scope:cbp_initialization_requested_country_quantity
							capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
						}
						set_global_variable = {
							name = cbp_initialization_market_allocated_quantity
							value = {
								value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_allocated_quantity
								add = scope:cbp_actual_added_quantity
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:cbp_actual_added_quantity != scope:cbp_initialization_requested_country_quantity
							}
							cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 15 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_initialization_allocated_quantity
			value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_allocated_quantity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_initialization_remaining_quantity
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity
				subtract = scope:cbp_initialization_allocated_quantity
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_initialization_negative_residue
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_initialization_allocated_quantity
				subtract = scope:cbp_opening_source_quantity
				min = 0
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:cbp_initialization_negative_residue > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon
			}
			set_global_variable = {
				name = cbp_initialization_validation_failures
				value = {
					value = global_var:cbp_initialization_validation_failures
					add = 1
				}
			}
			cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 16 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:cbp_initialization_remaining_quantity > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon
				exists = scope:cbp_initialization_residue_country
			}
			scope:cbp_initialization_residue_country = {
				cbp_add_stock = {
					country = this
					market = scope:cbp_initialization_market
					good = livestock
					quantity = scope:cbp_initialization_remaining_quantity
					capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
				}
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_initialization_market_allocated_quantity
					value = {
						value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_allocated_quantity
						add = scope:cbp_actual_added_quantity
					}
				}
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_initialization_residue_allocated_total
					value = {
						value = global_var:cbp_initialization_residue_allocated_total
						add = scope:cbp_actual_added_quantity
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:cbp_actual_added_quantity != scope:cbp_initialization_remaining_quantity
					}
					cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 17 }
				}
			}
		}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_initialization_allocated_quantity
			value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_allocated_quantity
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_initialization_allocated_total
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_initialization_allocated_total
				add = scope:cbp_initialization_allocated_quantity
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_initialization_market_goods_seeded
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_initialization_market_goods_seeded
				add = 1
			}
		}

		cbp_validate_stock_consistency = {
			market = scope:cbp_initialization_market
			good = livestock
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_validation_failed_after_rebuild > 0 }
			set_global_variable = {
				name = cbp_initialization_validation_failures
				value = {
					value = global_var:cbp_initialization_validation_failures
					add = 1
				}
			}
			cbp_initialization_mark_failure = { code = 18 }
			}
		}
	}

cbp_promote_market_to_detailed_accounting_good_livestock = {
	goods:livestock = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_promotion_good }
	scope:cbp_promotion_market = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market_country_cache_market
	}
	save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_consistency_controller
	cbp_rebuild_countries_present_in_market = yes
	cbp_scan_stock_sources_from_prepared_market_country_cache_good_livestock = yes

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before

			value = scope:cbp_scanned_market_stock

		}

		}
	}

			value = scope:cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before
			subtract = scope:cbp_promotion_country_sum_before
			min = 0
		}
	}

		name = cbp_promotion_overmaterialized_quantity
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_promotion_country_sum_before
			subtract = scope:cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before
			min = 0
		}
	}

	set_global_variable = {
		name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_goods_checked
		value = {
			value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_market_goods_checked
			add = 1
		}
	}

			value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_aggregate_total_before

		}
	}

		}
	}

		name = cbp_perf14_promotion_delta_total

			value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_delta_total

		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_promotion_overmaterialized_quantity > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon }
		set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_failure_detected value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_perf14_promotion_overmaterialized_failures
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_overmaterialized_failures
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before <= 0
			scope:cbp_promotion_country_sum_before <= 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_perf14_promotion_zero_source_count
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_zero_source_count
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_promotion_quantity_to_materialize > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon }
		set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_total_capacity value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_eligible_country_count value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_allocated_quantity value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_negative_capacity_failure value = 0 }
		remove_global_variable = cbp_perf14_promotion_residue_recipient_selected

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = {
							name = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
							target = scope:cbp_promotion_market
						}
					}
					save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
						name = cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity_raw
						value = "variable_map(cbp_stock_cap_by_market|scope:cbp_promotion_market)"
					}
				}
				else = {
					save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
						name = cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity_raw
						value = 0
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity
					value = {
						value = scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity_raw
						min = 0
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity_raw < 0 }
					set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_negative_capacity_failure value = 1 }
				}
				if = {

					if = {

							name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_total_capacity
							value = {
								value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_market_total_capacity
								add = scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_total_capacity value = scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_variable = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_eligible_country_count }

							name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_eligible_country_count
							value = {
								value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_market_eligible_country_count
								add = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_eligible_country_count value = 1 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_global_variable = cbp_perf14_promotion_residue_recipient_selected }
						}
						save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_perf14_promotion_residue_country
						set_global_variable = cbp_perf14_promotion_residue_recipient_selected
					}
				}
			}
		}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_total_capacity value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_total_capacity }

				name = cbp_perf14_promotion_total_capacity
				value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_market_total_capacity
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_negative_capacity_failure value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = cbp_perf14_promotion_market_negative_capacity_failure }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {

				value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_market_negative_capacity_failure
			}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_negative_capacity_failure > 0 }

			set_global_variable = {
				name = cbp_perf14_promotion_negative_capacity_failures
				value = {
					value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_negative_capacity_failures
					add = 1
				}
			}

		else_if = {

			set_global_variable = {
				name = cbp_perf14_promotion_zero_capacity_failures
				value = {
					value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_zero_capacity_failures
					add = 1
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			# cbp_add_stock increments the market aggregate. Rebase the aggregate
			# to the existing country sum first, then add only the aggregate-only delta.
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_expected_market_stock
				value = scope:cbp_promotion_country_sum_before
			}
			scope:cbp_promotion_market = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market }
			cbp_store_rebuilt_market_aggregate_good_livestock = yes

			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
				every_in_global_list = {
					variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable_map = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
							is_key_in_variable_map = {
								name = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
								target = scope:cbp_promotion_market
							}
							"variable_map(cbp_stock_cap_by_market|scope:cbp_promotion_market)" > 0
						}
						save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
							name = cbp_perf14_promotion_country_capacity
							value = "variable_map(cbp_stock_cap_by_market|scope:cbp_promotion_market)"

							value = {

								market = scope:cbp_promotion_market

							}

			if = {

			if = {

						good = livestock
						quantity = scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_remaining_quantity

					}
					if = {

						set_global_variable = {

							value = {

								add = scope:cbp_actual_added_quantity
							}
						}

			}

			scope:cbp_promotion_market = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market
				save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market_country_cache_market
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_consistency_controller
			cbp_rebuild_countries_present_in_market = yes
			cbp_scan_stock_sources_from_prepared_market_country_cache_good_livestock = yes

			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_perf14_promotion_final_country_sum_under
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before
					subtract = scope:cbp_expected_market_stock
					min = 0
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_perf14_promotion_final_country_sum_over
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_expected_market_stock
					subtract = scope:cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before
					min = 0
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_perf14_promotion_final_market_under
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before
					subtract = scope:cbp_scanned_market_stock
					min = 0

			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_perf14_promotion_final_market_over
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_scanned_market_stock
					subtract = scope:cbp_promotion_market_aggregate_before
					min = 0
				}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_final_country_sum_under > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon
						scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_final_country_sum_over > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon
						scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_final_market_under > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon
						scope:cbp_perf14_promotion_final_market_over > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon
					}
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = cbp_perf14_promotion_failure_detected value = 1 }
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_perf14_promotion_validation_failures
					value = {
						value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_validation_failures
						add = 1
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_global_variable = {
					name = cbp_perf14_promotion_goods_materialized
					value = {
						value = global_var:cbp_perf14_promotion_goods_materialized
						add = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		scope:cbp_promotion_market = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_dirty_market }
		cbp_mark_dirty_market_good_livestock = yes
	}
}

	# Fault injection for the deterministic CORE-01.6 test only.
	cbp_debug_corrupt_market_stock_good_livestock = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = cbp_livestock_market_stock
			is_key_in_global_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_livestock_market_stock
				target = scope:cbp_market
			}
		}
		remove_from_global_variable_map = {
			name = cbp_livestock_market_stock
			key = scope:cbp_market
		}
	}
	add_to_global_variable_map = {
		name = cbp_livestock_market_stock
		key = scope:cbp_market
		value = scope:cbp_debug_corrupted_market_stock
	}
	scope:cbp_market = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_dirty_market
	}
	cbp_mark_dirty_market_good_livestock = yes
}

cbp_core04_move_market_entry_stock_good_livestock = {
	goods:livestock = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_good }
	set_global_variable = {
		name = cbp_core04_market_entry_goods_checked
		value = {
			value = global_var:cbp_core04_market_entry_goods_checked
			add = 1
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_core04_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_country
		scope:cbp_core04_source_market = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market }
		cbp_read_country_stock_record_good_livestock = yes
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_core04_source_stock_before
			value = scope:cbp_read_country_stock
		}
	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_core04_requested_stock_move
		value = 0
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:cbp_core04_source_stock_before > 0
			scope:cbp_core04_move_ratio > 0
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_core04_requested_stock_move
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_core04_source_stock_before
				multiply = scope:cbp_core04_move_ratio
				min = 0
			}
		}
	}

	set_global_variable = {
		name = cbp_core04_market_entry_requested_stock_total
		value = {
			value = global_var:cbp_core04_market_entry_requested_stock_total
			add = scope:cbp_core04_requested_stock_move
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_core04_requested_stock_move > cbp_initialization_rounding_epsilon }
		cbp_transfer_stock = {
			seller_country = scope:cbp_core04_country
			buyer_country = scope:cbp_core04_country
			source_market = scope:cbp_core04_source_market
			target_market = scope:cbp_core04_target_market
			good = livestock
			quantity = scope:cbp_core04_requested_stock_move
			target_capacity_policy = allow_over_capacity
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cbp_core04_market_entry_actual_stock_total
			value = {
				value = global_var:cbp_core04_market_entry_actual_stock_total
				add = scope:cbp_actual_transferred_quantity
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_actual_transferred_quantity > 0 }
			set_global_variable = {
				name = cbp_core04_market_entry_goods_moved
				value = {
					value = global_var:cbp_core04_market_entry_goods_moved
					add = 1
				}
			}
		}
		cbp_validate_stock_consistency = {
			market = scope:cbp_core04_source_market
			good = livestock
		}
		cbp_validate_stock_consistency = {
			market = scope:cbp_core04_target_market
			good = livestock
		}
	}
}

cbp_calculate_overproduction_ratio_good_livestock = {
	cbp_load_void_economy_record_good_livestock = yes
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_produced_after
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us00_produced_before_raw
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_added_after
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us00_added_before_raw
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_rejected_after
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us00_rejected_before_raw
			min = 0
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_us00_produced_after > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_overproduction_ratio
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_us00_rejected_after
				divide = scope:cbp_us00_produced_after
				min = 0
				max = 1
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_overproduction_ratio
			value = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_effective_overproduction_ratio
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us00_overproduction_ratio
			subtract = cbp_overproduction_stability_buffer
			min = 0
			max = 1
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_void_wealth
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us00_void_wealth_before_raw
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_void_taxable_income_proxy
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us00_void_taxable_income_proxy_before_raw
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_production_penalty
		value = scope:cbp_us00_production_penalty_before_raw
	}
	cbp_store_void_economy_record_good_livestock = yes
}

			}

	}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_monthly_processing_required
		value = 0
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_us00_market_produced_gate > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_monthly_processing_required
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else = {
		cbp_probe_us00_previous_record_activity_good_livestock = yes
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_us00_previous_record_active > 0 }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us00_monthly_processing_required
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_us00_monthly_processing_required > 0 }
		cbp_load_void_economy_record_good_livestock = yes
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_previous_production_penalty
			value = scope:cbp_us00_production_penalty_before_raw
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_previous_record_active
			value = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:cbp_us00_produced_before_raw > 0
					scope:cbp_us00_added_before_raw > 0
					scope:cbp_us00_rejected_before_raw > 0
					scope:cbp_us00_void_wealth_before_raw > 0
					scope:cbp_us00_void_taxable_income_proxy_before_raw > 0
					scope:cbp_us00_overproduction_ratio_before_raw > 0
					scope:cbp_us00_effective_overproduction_ratio_before_raw > 0
					scope:cbp_us00_production_penalty_before_raw != 0
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us00_previous_record_active
				value = 1
			}
		}
		cbp_apply_us00_previous_penalty_good_livestock = yes
		cbp_clear_loaded_void_economy_record_good_livestock = yes
		cbp_clear_us00_ui_monthly_counters_good_livestock = yes
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_us00_market_produced_gate > 0 }
			cbp_ingest_us00_monthly_production_good_livestock = yes
		}
	}
}

cbp_apply_us00_previous_penalty_good_livestock = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_monthly_affected_locations_count
		value = 0
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us00_monthly_modifier_application_mode
		value = 0
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_us00_previous_production_penalty < 0 }
		scope:cbp_country = {
			set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us00_affected_locations_accumulator value = 0 }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = { market = scope:cbp_market }
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = cbp_us00_location_output_for_penalty
					value = {
						value = "goods_output(goods:livestock)"
						min = 0
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:cbp_us00_location_output_for_penalty > 0 }
					remove_location_modifier = cbp_livestock_production_penalty_modifier
					add_location_modifier = {
						modifier = cbp_livestock_production_penalty_modifier
						months = 1
						mode = replace
						size = scope:cbp_us00_previous_production_penalty
						desc = cbp_us00_production_penalty_modifier_desc
						recalculate_immediately = yes
					}
					scope:cbp_country = {
						change_local_variable = {
							name = cbp_us00_affected_locations_accumulator
							add = 1
						}
					}
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us00_monthly_affected_locations_count
				value = local_var:cbp_us00_affected_locations_accumulator
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_monthly_modifier_application_mode
			value = 1
		}
	}
}

cbp_ingest_us00_monthly_production_good_livestock = {
	scope:cbp_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us00_monthly_produced_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us00_monthly_positive_location_count value = 0 }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { market = scope:cbp_market }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us00_location_goods_output
				value = {
					value = "goods_output(goods:livestock)"
					min = 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_us00_location_goods_output > 0 }
				change_local_variable = {
					name = cbp_us00_monthly_produced_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_location_goods_output
				}
				change_local_variable = {
					name = cbp_us00_monthly_positive_location_count
					add = 1
				}
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_monthly_produced_quantity
			value = {
				value = local_var:cbp_us00_monthly_produced_accumulator
				min = 0
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_monthly_positive_locations_count
			value = local_var:cbp_us00_monthly_positive_location_count
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_us00_monthly_produced_quantity > 0 }
		cbp_add_stock = {
			country = scope:cbp_country
			market = scope:cbp_market
			good = livestock
			quantity = scope:cbp_us00_monthly_produced_quantity
			capacity_policy = enforce
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_monthly_actual_added_quantity
			value = scope:cbp_actual_added_quantity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_monthly_rejected_quantity
			value = scope:cbp_rejected_quantity
		}
		scope:cbp_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us00_monthly_good_price
				value = {
					value = "market_price(goods:livestock)"
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_monthly_good_price_source
			value = 1
		}

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_produced_after
			value = scope:cbp_us00_monthly_produced_quantity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_added_after
			value = scope:cbp_us00_monthly_actual_added_quantity
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_rejected_after
			value = scope:cbp_us00_monthly_rejected_quantity
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_us00_produced_after > 0 }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us00_overproduction_ratio
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_us00_rejected_after
					divide = scope:cbp_us00_produced_after
					min = 0
					max = 1
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us00_overproduction_ratio value = 0 }
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_effective_overproduction_ratio
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_us00_overproduction_ratio
				subtract = cbp_overproduction_stability_buffer
				min = 0
				max = 1
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_void_wealth
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_us00_rejected_after
				multiply = scope:cbp_us00_monthly_good_price
				multiply = cbp_void_wealth_price_weight
				min = 0
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_void_taxable_income_proxy
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_us00_void_wealth
				multiply = cbp_void_taxable_income_proxy_ratio
				min = 0
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_void_wealth_delta
			value = scope:cbp_us00_void_wealth
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_production_penalty_magnitude
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_us00_effective_overproduction_ratio
				multiply = cbp_production_penalty_per_effective_overproduction
				min = 0
				max = cbp_max_production_penalty
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_production_penalty
			value = {
				value = 0
				subtract = scope:cbp_us00_production_penalty_magnitude
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_us00_production_penalty_application_mode
			value = 0
		}
		cbp_update_void_wealth_aggregates = yes
		cbp_store_void_economy_record_good_livestock = yes
		cbp_capture_us00_monthly_runtime_debug_good_livestock = yes
	}
}

cbp_prepare_us10_candidate_good_livestock = {
	cbp_prepare_stock_candidate_scoring_defaults = yes
	scope:cbp_candidate_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_country
		scope:cbp_market = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market }
		cbp_read_country_stock_record_good_livestock = yes
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_candidate_stock value = scope:cbp_read_country_stock }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_candidate_stock value = scope:cbp_read_country_stock }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_candidate_capacity value = scope:cbp_read_country_stock_cap }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us10_candidate_capacity_floor
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_capacity
			multiply = scope:cbp_us10_supplier_min_stock_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us10_candidate_negative_balance_reserve
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_capacity
			multiply = scope:cbp_us10_supplier_negative_balance_reserve_ratio
			min = 0
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_candidate_monthly_added value = 0 }
	scope:cbp_candidate_country = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_livestock_added_by_market
				is_key_in_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_livestock_added_by_market
					target = scope:cbp_market
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us10_candidate_monthly_added
				value = "variable_map(cbp_livestock_added_by_market|scope:cbp_market)"
			}
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_candidate_monthly_requested value = 0 }
	scope:cbp_candidate_country = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_consumption_livestock_requested_by_market
				is_key_in_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_consumption_livestock_requested_by_market
					target = scope:cbp_market
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_us10_candidate_monthly_requested
				value = "variable_map(cbp_consumption_livestock_requested_by_market|scope:cbp_market)"
			}
		}
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
		name = cbp_us10_candidate_monthly_net_balance
		value = {
			value = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_monthly_added
			subtract = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_monthly_requested
		}
	}
	cbp_apply_current_stock_candidate_stock_filters = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_us10_candidate_allowed > 0 }
		cbp_prepare_current_stock_candidate_relations = yes
		cbp_apply_current_stock_candidate_hard_filters = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_us10_candidate_allowed > 0 }
		cbp_calculate_current_stock_candidate_score = yes
	}
}

				target = scope:cbp_market
			}
		}

		}

	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_market_aggregate_prefilter_used value = 0 }

		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_market_aggregate_prefilter_used value = 1 }

			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_us10_candidate_take_quantity > 0 }
			cbp_remove_stock = {
				country = scope:cbp_consumer_country
				market = scope:cbp_market
				good = livestock
				quantity = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_take_quantity
				reason = consumption
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_satisfied_quantity
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_satisfied_quantity
					add = scope:cbp_actual_removed_quantity
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_remaining_quantity
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_remaining_quantity
					subtract = scope:cbp_actual_removed_quantity
					min = 0
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_own_stock_fast_path_used value = 1 }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_own_stock_taken value = scope:cbp_actual_removed_quantity }
			cbp_audit_log_us10_consumption_mutation_trace_good_livestock = yes
		}
	}
}

cbp_rebuild_us10_sparse_suppliers_good_livestock = {
	cbp_clear_us10_sparse_supplier_list_good_livestock = yes
	scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
		set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_source_count value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_count value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
				change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_source_count add = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = cbp_livestock_stock_by_market
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = cbp_livestock_stock_by_market
						target = scope:cbp_market
					}
					"variable_map(cbp_livestock_stock_by_market|scope:cbp_market)" > scope:cbp_us10_minimum_stock_to_consider
				}
				save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_country
				add_to_global_variable_list = {
					name = cbp_livestock_us10_sparse_suppliers
					target = scope:cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_country
				}
				scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
					change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_count add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_source_count value = local_var:cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_source_count }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_count value = local_var:cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_count }
	}
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_scan_used value = 0 }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_sparse_supplier_fallback_used value = 0 }
}

cbp_scan_us10_candidate_country_good_livestock = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_candidate_country
	scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
		change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_candidate_count add = 1 }
	}
	cbp_prepare_us10_candidate_good_livestock = yes
	cbp_audit_log_us10_candidate_trace_good_livestock = yes
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_us10_candidate_allowed > 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_us10_candidate_priority_bucket = 1 }
				scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
					change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_bucket_1_candidates add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_us10_candidate_priority_bucket = 2 }
				scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
					change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_bucket_2_candidates add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_us10_candidate_priority_bucket = 3 }
				scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
					change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_bucket_3_candidates add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
					change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_bucket_4_candidates add = 1 }
				}
			}
			scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = cbp_us10_total_available_candidate_stock
				add = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_stock
			}
		}
		scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_us10_stock_candidate_score > local_var:cbp_us10_best_stock_priority_score }
				set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_best_stock_priority_score value = scope:cbp_us10_stock_candidate_score }
				set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_best_candidate_stock value = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_stock }
				set_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_best_candidate_bucket value = scope:cbp_us10_candidate_priority_bucket }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {
			change_local_variable = { name = cbp_us10_excluded_candidate_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	# Candidate scan counters must live on a persistent country/controller scope.

	scope:cbp_us10_resolution_controller = {

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_excluded_candidate_count value = local_var:cbp_us10_excluded_candidate_count }

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_best_stock_priority_score value = local_var:cbp_us10_best_stock_priority_score }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_best_candidate_stock value = local_var:cbp_us10_best_candidate_stock }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_best_candidate_bucket value = local_var:cbp_us10_best_candidate_bucket }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_negative_balance_exclusions value = local_var:cbp_us10_negative_balance_exclusions }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_bucket_1_candidates value = local_var:cbp_us10_bucket_1_candidates }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us10_bucket_2_candidates value = local_var:cbp_us10_bucket_2_candidates }

cbp_queue_monthly_stock_consumption_good_livestock = {
	scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_country = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market
				is_key_in_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market
					target = scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_market
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_monthly_consumption_pending_before
				value = "variable_map(cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market|scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_market)"
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market
				key = scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_market
			}
		}
		else = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_monthly_consumption_pending_before value = 0 }
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_monthly_consumption_pending_after
			value = {
				value = scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_pending_before
				add = scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_requested_quantity
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market
				is_key_in_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market
					target = scope:cbp_market
				}
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_monthly_consumption_pending_quantity
				value = "variable_map(cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market|scope:cbp_market)"
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_consumption_livestock_pending_requested_by_market
				key = scope:cbp_market
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_pending_quantity > 0 }
		cbp_resolve_stock_consumption = {
			consumer_country = scope:cbp_country
			market = scope:cbp_market
			good = livestock
			requested_quantity = scope:cbp_monthly_consumption_pending_quantity
		}
		cbp_note_us10_monthly_consumption_request_processed = {
			requested_quantity = scope:cbp_requested_quantity
			satisfied_quantity = scope:cbp_satisfied_quantity
			unsatisfied_quantity = scope:cbp_unsatisfied_quantity
		}
	}
}

cbp_record_pop_demand_outcome_good_livestock = {
	scope:cbp_demand_location = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_pop_demand_requested_quantity
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_requested_quantity target = scope:cbp_good }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_requested_before value = "variable_map(cbp_pop_demand_requested_quantity|scope:cbp_good)" }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_requested_quantity key = scope:cbp_good }
		}
		else = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_requested_before value = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_quantity
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_quantity target = scope:cbp_good }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_satisfied_before value = "variable_map(cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_quantity|scope:cbp_good)" }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_quantity key = scope:cbp_good }
		}
		else = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_satisfied_before value = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_quantity
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_quantity target = scope:cbp_good }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_unsatisfied_before value = "variable_map(cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_quantity|scope:cbp_good)" }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_quantity key = scope:cbp_good }
		}
		else = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_unsatisfied_before value = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months target = scope:cbp_good }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_satisfied_months_before value = "variable_map(cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months|scope:cbp_good)" }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months key = scope:cbp_good }
		}
		else = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_satisfied_months_before value = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months target = scope:cbp_good }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_unsatisfied_months_before value = "variable_map(cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months|scope:cbp_good)" }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months key = scope:cbp_good }
		}
		else = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_pop_unsatisfied_months_before value = 0 } }
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = cbp_pop_demand_requested_quantity
			key = scope:cbp_good
			value = { value = scope:cbp_pop_requested_before add = scope:cbp_outcome_requested_quantity }
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_quantity
			key = scope:cbp_good
			value = { value = scope:cbp_pop_satisfied_before add = scope:cbp_outcome_satisfied_quantity }
		}
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_quantity
			key = scope:cbp_good
			value = { value = scope:cbp_pop_unsatisfied_before add = scope:cbp_outcome_unsatisfied_quantity }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_outcome_unsatisfied_quantity > 0 }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months_computed_value
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_pop_unsatisfied_months_before
					add = 1
				}
			}
			add_to_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months key = scope:cbp_good value = scope:cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months_computed_value }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months key = scope:cbp_good value = scope:cbp_pop_satisfied_months_before }
		}
		else = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months_computed_value
				value = {
					value = scope:cbp_pop_satisfied_months_before
					add = 1
				}
			}
			add_to_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months key = scope:cbp_good value = scope:cbp_pop_demand_satisfied_months_computed_value }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = cbp_pop_demand_unsatisfied_months key = scope:cbp_good value = scope:cbp_pop_unsatisfied_months_before }
		}
	}
}

# Literal persistence adapter for olives.

cbp_mark_dirty_market_good_olives = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_olives_dirty_markets }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = {
			name = cbp_olives_dirty_markets
			target = scope:cbp_dirty_market
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = {
					name = cbp_olives_dirty_markets
					target = scope:cbp_dirty_market
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = {
			name = cbp_olives_dirty_markets
			target = scope:cbp_dirty_market
		}
	}
}

cbp_clear_dirty_markets_good_olives = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_olives_dirty_markets }
		clear_global_variable_list = cbp_olives_dirty_markets
	}
}

cbp_mark_active_market_good_olives = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_olives_active_markets }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = {
			name = cbp_olives_active_markets
			target = scope:cbp_active_market
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = {
					name = cbp_olives_active_markets
					target = scope:cbp_active_market
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = {
			name = cbp_olives_active_markets
			target = scope:cbp_active_market
		}
	}
	cbp_mark_active_market_any_good = yes
}

cbp_clear_active_markets_good_olives = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_olives_active_markets }
		clear_global_variable_list = cbp_olives_active_markets
	}
}

cbp_repair_active_markets_good_olives = {
	cbp_perf13_increment_active_repair_goods_scanned = yes

	every_market_in_world = {
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market
		save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_repair_active_market

		scope:cbp_active_repair_controller = {
			set_local_variable = {
				name = cbp_active_repair_current_market_has_state
				value = 0
			}
		}
		cbp_perf13_increment_active_repair_market_good_scans = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = cbp_olives_market_stock
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_market_stock
					target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
				}
				"global_variable_map(cbp_olives_market_stock|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
			}
			scope:cbp_active_repair_controller = {
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cbp_active_repair_current_market_has_state
					value = 1
				}
			}
			cbp_perf13_increment_active_repair_market_aggregate_hits = yes
		}

		scope:cbp_repair_active_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market_country_cache_market
		}
		cbp_rebuild_countries_present_in_market = yes

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
				cbp_perf13_increment_active_repair_country_source_checks = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_stock_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_produced_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_produced_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_produced_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_added_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_added_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_added_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_rejected_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_rejected_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_rejected_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_overproduction_ratio_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_overproduction_ratio_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_overproduction_ratio_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_effective_overproduction_ratio_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_effective_overproduction_ratio_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_effective_overproduction_ratio_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_void_wealth_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_void_wealth_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_void_wealth_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_void_taxable_income_proxy_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_void_taxable_income_proxy_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_void_taxable_income_proxy_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" > 0
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable_map = cbp_olives_production_penalty_by_market
								is_key_in_variable_map = {
									name = cbp_olives_production_penalty_by_market
									target = scope:cbp_repair_active_market
								}
								"variable_map(cbp_olives_production_penalty_by_market|scope:cbp_repair_active_market)" != 0
							}
						}
					}
					scope:cbp_active_repair_controller = {
						set_local_variable = {
							name = cbp_active_repair_current_market_has_state
							value = 1
						}
					}
					cbp_perf13_increment_active_repair_country_state_hits = yes
				}
			}
		}

		scope:cbp_active_repair_controller = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
				name = cbp_active_repair_current_market_has_state
				value = local_var:cbp_active_repair_current_market_has_state
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_active_repair_current_market_has_state > 0 }
			scope:cbp_repair_active_market = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_active_market
			}
			cbp_mark_active_market_good_olives = yes
			cbp_perf13_increment_active_repair_market_goods_marked = yes
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

cbp_store_stock_record_good_olives = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_country_record_write_required = 1 }
		scope:cbp_country = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
						target = scope:cbp_market
					}
				}
				remove_from_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					key = scope:cbp_market
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_country_stock_after > 0 }
				add_to_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					key = scope:cbp_market
					value = scope:cbp_country_stock_after
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_market_record_write_required = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = cbp_olives_market_stock
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_market_stock
					target = scope:cbp_market
				}
			}
			remove_from_global_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_olives_market_stock
				key = scope:cbp_market
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_market_stock_after > 0 }
			add_to_global_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_olives_market_stock
				key = scope:cbp_market
				value = scope:cbp_market_stock_after
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:cbp_country_stock_after > 0
				scope:cbp_market_stock_after > 0
			}
		}
		scope:cbp_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_active_market
		}
		cbp_mark_active_market_good_olives = yes
	}
}

cbp_probe_us00_previous_record_activity_good_olives = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us00_previous_record_active value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:cbp_country = {
				has_variable_map = cbp_olives_us00_active_record_by_market
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_us00_active_record_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = cbp_us00_previous_record_active value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:cbp_country = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_olives_produced_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_produced_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_olives_added_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_added_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_olives_rejected_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_rejected_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_olives_overproduction_ratio_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_overproduction_ratio_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
					}
					AND = {

					AND = {

						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_void_wealth_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_olives_void_taxable_income_proxy_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_void_taxable_income_proxy_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
					}
					AND = {
						has_variable_map = cbp_olives_production_penalty_by_market
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = cbp_olives_production_penalty_by_market target = scope:cbp_market }
					}
				}
			}
		}

	}

cbp_store_transfer_records_good_olives = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_seller_record_write_required = 1 }
		scope:cbp_seller_country = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
						target = scope:cbp_source_market
					}
				}
				remove_from_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					key = scope:cbp_source_market
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_seller_stock_after > 0 }
				add_to_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					key = scope:cbp_source_market
					value = scope:cbp_seller_stock_after
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_buyer_record_write_required = 1 }
		scope:cbp_buyer_country = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
						target = scope:cbp_target_market
					}
				}
				remove_from_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					key = scope:cbp_target_market
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:cbp_buyer_stock_after > 0 }
				add_to_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					key = scope:cbp_target_market
					value = scope:cbp_buyer_stock_after
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_market_transfer_write_required = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = cbp_olives_market_stock
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_market_stock
					target = scope:cbp_source_market
				}
			}
			remove_from_global_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_olives_market_stock
				key = scope:cbp_source_market
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_source_market_stock_after > 0 }
			add_to_global_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_olives_market_stock
				key = scope:cbp_source_market
				value = scope:cbp_source_market_stock_after
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = cbp_olives_market_stock
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = {
					name = cbp_olives_market_stock
					target = scope:cbp_target_market
				}
			}
			remove_from_global_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_olives_market_stock
				key = scope:cbp_target_market
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:cbp_target_market_stock_after > 0 }
			add_to_global_variable_map = {
				name = cbp_olives_market_stock
				key = scope:cbp_target_market
				value = scope:cbp_target_market_stock_after
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:cbp_seller_stock_after > 0
				scope:cbp_source_market_stock_after > 0
			}
		}
		scope:cbp_source_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_active_market
		}
		cbp_mark_active_market_good_olives = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:cbp_buyer_stock_after > 0
				scope:cbp_target_market_stock_after > 0
			}
		}
		scope:cbp_target_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_active_market
		}
		cbp_mark_active_market_good_olives = yes
	}
}

cbp_scan_stock_sources_from_prepared_market_country_cache_good_olives = {
	scope:cbp_consistency_controller = {
		set_local_variable = {
			name = cbp_scan_expected_market_stock
			value = 0
		}
		set_local_variable = {
			name = cbp_scan_country_source_count
			value = 0
		}
		set_local_variable = {
			name = cbp_scan_negative_country_source_detected
			value = 0
		}
		set_local_variable = {
			name = cbp_scan_over_cap_country_source_detected
			value = 0
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
					is_key_in_variable_map = {
						name = cbp_olives_stock_by_market
						target = scope:cbp_market
					}
				}
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = cbp_scanned_country_stock
					value = "variable_map(cbp_olives_stock_by_market|scope:cbp_market)"
				}
				scope:cbp_consistency_controller = {
					change_local_variable = {
						name = cbp_scan_expected_market_stock
						add = scope:cbp_scanned_country_stock
					}
					change_local_variable = {
						name = cbp_scan_country_source_count
						add = 1
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:cbp_scanned_country_stock < 0 }
					scope:cbp_consistency_controller = {
						set_local_variable = {
							name = cbp_scan_negative_country_source_detected
							value = 1
						}
					}
				}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable_map = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
							is_key_in_variable_map = {
								name = cbp_stock_cap_by_market
								target = scope:cbp_market
							}
						}
						save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
							name = cbp_scanned_country_capacity
							value = "variable_map(cbp_stock_cap_by_market|scope:cbp_market)"
						}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:cbp_scanned_country_stock > scope:cbp_scanned_country_capacity
						}
						scope:cbp_consistency_controller = {
							set_local_variable = {
								name = cbp_scan_over_cap_country_source_detected
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_consistency_controller = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_expected_market_stock
			value = local_var:cbp_scan_expected_market_stock
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_country_source_count
			value = local_var:cbp_scan_country_source_count
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_negative_country_source_detected
			value = local_var:cbp_scan_negative_country_source_detected
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = cbp_over_cap_country_source_detected
			value = local_var:cbp_scan_over_cap_country_source_detected
		}
	}

	cbp_load_market_aggregate_good_olives = yes
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_expected_market_stock > 0 }
		add_to_global_variable_map = {
			name = cbp_olives_market_stock
			key = scope:cbp_market
			value = scope:cbp_expected_market_stock
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:cbp_expected_market_stock > 0 }
		scope:cbp_market = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_active_market
		}
		cbp_mark_active_market_good_olives = yes
	}
}

	cbp_debug_capture_rebuild_market_stock = yes

cbp_rebuild_market_stock_from_current_scan_good_olives = {
